logp.method_description: The partition coefficient of compounds 1–3 was measured by the shake-flask method. A mixture of equal volumes of n-octanol and water was shaken at room temperature for 24 h on a mechanical shaker in order to saturate each phase with the other phase. The mixture was centrifugated for the separation of phases. For each compound, a stock solution in water pre-saturated with n-octanol was prepared. A volume (Vwater) of this solution was shaken for 30 min with a volume of water-saturated n-octanol (Voct). Usually, the volumes of n-octanol and water are equal, but for compounds with extreme log Po/w values different volumes must be used (in the actual case, Vwater/Voct = 1/19 for 1, 1/1 for 2 and 9/1 for 3). Phase separation was carried out by the centrifugation of the vessels for 30 min at 4000 rpm. The platinum content in the initial ([C]init.water) and final ([C]fin.water) aqueous phases was determined by means of inductively coupled plasma-optical emission spectrometry (ICP-OES).
